caption: The drawing features a group of wooden objects arranged on a wooden base. At the center, there are two turned wooden columns with rounded tops and bases, each connected by a central, horizontally positioned wooden spindle with a carved handle-like middle section. Attached to the left column is a small clamp or vise-like wooden tool with a rectangular form and a cylindrical handle. To the right, affixed to the second column, is a metal fork-like tool with two prongs extending outward. Behind the columns, on the right, is a hatchet or axe with a wooden handle and angled head, which is resting against the arrangement. In the lower right foreground, there is a wooden razor-like tool, with a straight edge and a light brown handle, lying on the wooden base. The wooden base itself is irregularly shaped with dark brown tones and visible wood grain lines, supporting the entire composition. The colors in the drawing are predominantly shades of brown and tan, representing wood, with some metallic gray visible on the fork-pronged tool. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the objects.
title: Apple Parer
